m: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 2 parts water for 12 minutes. Drain and fluff.
Cut the chicken into chunks and brown in a little oil. Set aside.
Soften the onion 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and all the spices for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, drained chickpeas, zucchini in chunks and stock powder with ½ cup water per 2 serves. Simmer 10 minutes.
Return the chicken and simmer 8 minutes more until cooked through. Finish with lemon juice and salt.
Serve over quinoa with parsley and a spoon of yoghurt.
l: Freezes and reheats well. Pack the yoghurt separately.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the stock powder.
